summary: Trillion Energy International Inc. filed Form 6-K announcing a ceremonial CSE opening bell for its five-year exchange anniversary and a 5:1 share consolidation effective April 24, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine corporate update with no special-situation event; the share consolidation is a standard capital adjustment, not a capital return or activist event. No deal terms, premium, or board recommendations are present.
